project.description: The project directory this thread belongs to, if any.

worktree.description:
The project's linked Git worktree the thread runs in; `None` in the
project's own checkout.

pullRequest.description: The most recently observed pull request for this checkout branch.

harness.description: Configuration key of the ACP harness.

harnessName.description: Display name of the ACP harness.

lifecycle.description: Where it stands in the user's triage.

shelf.description: The part of the list it belongs in.

attention.description: Why it wants the user, if it does.

lastInputAt.description: The user's latest input, in Unix milliseconds.

updatedAt.description:
Time of the last input or turn end in Unix milliseconds; zero if
unknown.

model.description: Display name of the selected model, once reported.

thinking.description: Display name of the selected thinking level, when the model has one.

ForkSource.description: Where a thread was forked from.

thread.description: The source thread, which may be gone.

entry.description: The last of its entries the fork shares, if any.

Lifecycle.description:
A thread's place in triage. Every change returns the lifecycle before it,
which [`TriageAction::Restore`] puts back.

snoozedUntil.description: Put off until this time, in Unix milliseconds.

pin.description: Position among pinned threads, if pinned; lower is higher up.

order.description:
Position among active threads, if the user arranged it. Threads without
one come first, the latest input on top.

unread.description: A turn settled while no app was watching, or the user marked it.

Standing.description: Whether the user is done with a thread.

oneOf.description: Open, and settled by the usual rules.

Brought back by the user or a due snooze: it does not settle by itself
until it gets new input.
Done. New input or agent activity opens it again.
Its pull request was merged or closed.

AutoSettle.description: A thread's say in automatic settlement.

oneOf.description: By the usual rules.

Shelf.description: The part of the thread list a thread belongs in.

oneOf.description: Running, queued, or waiting for work it delegated.

Attention.description: Why a thread wants the user.

oneOf.description: The agent awaits a permission.
The agent awaits an answer.
Its last run failed, unseen.
Something finished, unseen.

Project.description: A working directory shared by a group of threads.

settings.description: Project preferences shared by all clients.

path.description: Absolute directory path.

git.description:
Whether the directory is inside a Git checkout, so its threads can
run in worktrees.

branch.description:
The checkout's current branch; `None` outside Git or on a detached
HEAD.

ProjectSettings.description: Stored project preferences. Optional defaults inherit from the environment.

ProjectIcon.description:
Icon selection advertised in project summaries. Image bytes are read
separately.

blob.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest stored in the workspace blob store.

TaskId.description:
A delegated task's id, allocated by the environment that owns the parent
thread.

Empty.description: Empty successful response or notification params.
